# textproto

Types from the Go package `textproto` (a library PocketBase builds on), as JavaScript sees them: they turn up as values of [PocketBase's types](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and of hook events.

## textproto.MIMEHeader

A MIMEHeader represents a MIME-style header mapping
keys to sets of values.

Has everything <code>{ [key: string]: any }</code> has.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `add()` | <code>(key: string, value: string): void</code> | Add adds the key, value pair to the header. It appends to any existing values associated with key. |
| `set()` | <code>(key: string, value: string): void</code> | Set sets the header entries associated with key to the single element value. It replaces any existing values associated with key. |
| `get()` | <code>(key: string): string</code> | Get gets the first value associated with the given key. It is case insensitive; `CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey` is used to canonicalize the provided key. If there are no values associated with the key, Get returns "". To use non-canonical keys, access the map directly. |
| `values()` | <code>(key: string): Array&lt;string&gt;</code> | Values returns all values associated with the given key. It is case insensitive; `CanonicalMIMEHeaderKey` is used to canonicalize the provided key. To use non-canonical keys, access the map directly. The returned slice is not a copy. |
| `del()` | <code>(key: string): void</code> | Del deletes the values associated with key. |
